sanitizationReport.summary: 3 deduped findings reconciled. NONE suppressed by known issues: the 14 documented known issues / design decisions cover the staking emission model (NFTStaker), owner/pauser centralization, empty-pool guards, floor rounding, zero-APY mode, APY-as-floor semantics, single-ID isolation and _safePay/dust — none document batchMint reentrancy, MEV front-run of the nudge pot, or the minReward-default opt-out. All 3 survive to classification. DEDUP-002 is reconciled as residual-of-acknowledged (M-01) and must NOT be re-reported as a new finding nor have its acknowledged status overwritten. DEDUP-001 is a still-open escalation candidate on L-01 (status preserved). ECON-002 is confirmed genuinely new.
criticalRulesApplied: Human triage is authoritative: sanitizer PROPOSES, /ledger DISPOSES. M-01 'acknowledged' and L-01 'submitted' statuses are NOT auto-overwritten.

Design-decision-vs-accepted-finding precedence CONFIRMED: the 'winner-take-all nudge pot' framing appears in the project design decisions, but M-01 was explicitly ACCEPTED as a valid finding in human triage (status=acknowledged, with a triage note proposing the minRewardPayout mitigation). An accepted-in-triage finding is NOT re-suppressed by a generic design-decision note. DEDUP-002's residual therefore survives.
High-severity caution: DEDUP-001's Low->High escalation is gated on a Tier-3 PoC and flagged for human review; sanitizer does not commit the severity flip.

knownIssueDecision.reason: No documented known issue covers batchMint reentrancy. The project's own systemAssumptions REQUIRE OpenZeppelin ReentrancyGuard ('OpenZeppelin used for ... ReentrancyGuard - custom reimplementations prohibited'), and the sibling NFTStaker guards every entry point. The missing guard on batchMint is a deviation from the project's stated convention, not an accepted design decision.

passedFindings.humanReviewFlag: ESCALATION OF A DELIBERATELY-DOWNGRADED FINDING. Prior run adjudicated this NOT-exploitable by analysing only the idempotent-to-zero nudge-pot leg. DEDUP-001 identifies a DIFFERENT non-idempotent value-out path (payment-token dust refund at L287-289 sweeps live balanceOf(this) to the current frame's msg.sender, so a re-entrant inner frame carries an outer victim's unspent paymentAmount to the attacker). Severity flip requires a Tier-3 PoC demonstrating cross-party extraction under a realistic deployment (nudge funded / victim batch with a contract recipient). The third-party-funding trigger relies on the out-of-submodule BalancerPoolerV2 integration (story-031), which must be validated as in-scope-rooted and not a known-invalid user/integration mistake before the High stands. Absent the PoC, validated state remains L-01 Low.

passedFindings.title: Winner-take-all balance-based nudge pot remains MEV-capturable; story-015 minReward protects the loser's spend but does not stop a front-runner winning the pot (residual of M-01)

knownIssueDecision.reason: REASONING CONFIRMED PER INSTRUCTION. The 'winner-take-all nudge pot' and 'owner trust' framings are design decisions in the project docs, which would normally suppress a finding restating that structure. BUT M-01 (the parent of this residual) was EXPLICITLY ACCEPTED as a valid finding in human triage on 2026-05-29 (ledger status=acknowledged, triage note: 'Accepted - valid finding. Mitigation: introduce a minRewardPayout parameter ...'). An accepted-in-triage finding takes precedence over the generic design-decision note: the sponsor's own triage treats the MEV exposure as a real issue to be mitigated, not an accepted design property. story-015 implemented only the loser-overpay leg of that mitigation (minReward floor); the front-runner-wins-the-pot leg is unchanged. The residual is therefore NOT suppressed by the design-decision note.
